evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 4.8 ppm after remaining approximately 4–7 ppm through most of the ramp.
Oxygen increased to 8.4 ppm during growth.
Oxygen reached 21.9 ppm, a sustained departure from the established purged baseline.
Temperature 749.8 °C tracks 750 °C setpoint, argon 99.9 sccm tracks 100 sccm setpoint, heater power is stable at 45.3%, and status remains running; these do not explain the oxygen rise.
Pressure gauge is not installed; null pressure readings are not evidence of a sensor fault.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and a leak-integrity/exhaust-flow check are needed to distinguish air ingress from exhaust restriction, oxygen release, or sensor error; pressure is unobserved. No sample characterization is available.
